bio:
Petri Lahdelma is a Finnish designer with more than 20 years between design and code. He has led design system teams from local to global enterprises and laid the award-winning groundwork for the Helsinki Design System. He grew up in Turku as the son of a painter and still believes clarity matters more than decoration.

His work sits where design systems, accessibility and AI meet: component contracts that agents can read, evidence that a check actually ran and the people who still need to be in the room. He writes about it here.

He studied graphic design at the University of Cumbria and holds a master's degree from Aalto University. He is a member of AIGA, IxDA and ISTD.
